newsitem.title: VENEZUELA: Venezuela committee approves Hamaca oil contract.
newsitem.headline: Venezuela committee approves Hamaca oil contract.

text.p: Venezuela's bicameral Energy and Mines Committee on Tuesday unanimously approved the Hamaca Orinoco oil contract, opening the way to final approval in a full session of Congress, Venezuela's Senate said in a statement on Wednesday.

The $3.5 billion venture between ARCO, Texaco, Phillips and state oil subsidiary Corpoven plans to produce 200,000 barrels per day of extra-heavy Orinoco oil and convert it into lighter crude for export.
Congress has already approved the legal basis of the Hamaca deal, so it lacks only a rubber stamp on the contract itself which should occur within the next few days.
Hamaca is one of six such projects designed to exploit Venezuela's estimated 270 billion barrels of extra-heavy Orinoco oil reserves.
